{{Top|leg}}
A '''repulsorlift conveyor''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] tool. It was used to sift the usable [[Ore/Legends|ore]] from the useless material that surrounded it. The [[Multi-Environment Mining Droid MEMD-2]] had an internal [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] conveyor.
